audience: Developers who already use AI tools and want a clearer way to run parallel agent work inside an editor.
mandatory_topics: Parallel Agents lets users run multiple agent threads at once.
The Threads Sidebar is the main place to start, manage, and switch between threads.
Different threads can use different agents, including external agents such as Codex through ACP.
The campaign should include at least one grounded point about Zed's open-source, Rust, or GPU-accelerated foundation.
must_avoid: Unsupported speed claims beyond the source packet
Claims that agents work without user review or project context
